snippet.title: The Inverted Tower - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
First, a quick thank you to @Toastyfunnyguy for making this trailer and helping me!! I very much appreciate it!

I've been working on this game for 6-8 months now and I have been updating the demo on both itch.io and Steam fairly consistently, but the one thing I always felt I was missing was a trailer. 

If you are interested in what you see, check out the game in the links below!! The demo and full release of the game are/will be 100% free :)

LINKS:
https://cmrngames.itch.io/the-inverted-tower
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885530/The_Inverted_Tower/
(Quick disclaimer: this game is intended for adults and contains mature content in that regard.)

OVERVIEW:
A dream was given to all mankind, telling of a tower that would fall from the heavens above, and inside would lie a chalice. This chalice is said to grant its wielder one wish, any wish they could ever desire - but there's a catch.

This chalice lies at the end of a cruel and unforgiving labyrinth inside of the Inverted Tower. Once you enter, you cannot leave, and no one knows how far the tower goes... 

Play as Kristoff, 20-year-old farm hand and blacksmith who has left the safety of his exile to seek out this chalice and bring a cure to the disease plaguing his nation's land. Alone or with the help of others you'll meet along the way, decisions made will affect the lives of EVERYONE held captive in this twisted tower.
